documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our facilities management team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's facilities management team is exploring options but has not identified a specific requirement or project owner. This lack of clarity is creating operational friction, as the team is unable to proceed with arranging a discovery meeting without further clarification.

claims.quote: We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your facilities management team is in the early stages of exploring options. To help move things forward, could you clarify what specific needs or goals you're looking to address? This will allow us to better prepare for a discovery meeting and ensure it aligns with your priorities.
questions: What specific challenges or goals is your facilities management team currently facing?
Are there any existing systems or tools you're currently using that you'd like to integrate with?
uncertainties: The lack of a defined requirement or project owner may delay the discovery process.
The absence of a clear use case may limit the effectiveness of the discovery meeting.
